definitions.gloss: vegetable compartment; crisper drawer (in a refrigerator)
definitions.explanation: The dedicated compartment in a refrigerator for storing vegetables. Designed to maintain higher humidity and a slightly warmer temperature than the main compartment to keep produce fresh.

examples.japanese: {野菜室|やさいしつ}にレタスを{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I put the lettuce in the vegetable compartment.

examples.japanese: {野菜室|やさいしつ}は{冷蔵室|れいぞうしつ}より{温度|おんど}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: The vegetable compartment is warmer than the main refrigerator compartment.

examples.japanese: {大型|おおがた}{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}は{野菜室|やさいしつ}が{広|ひろ}くて{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: Large refrigerators have spacious vegetable compartments that are easy to use.

notes:
Compound of {野菜|やさい} (vegetables) + {室|しつ} (room, compartment). One of several specialized compartments in modern Japanese refrigerators.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野菜室|やさいしつ}に{入|い}れる: to put in the vegetable compartment
- {野菜室|やさいしつ}から{出|だ}す: to take out of the vegetable compartment
- {野菜室|やさいしつ}が{大|おお}きい: has a large vegetable compartment

RELATED REFRIGERATOR COMPARTMENTS:
- {冷蔵室|れいぞうしつ}: main refrigerator compartment
- {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}: freezer compartment
- チルド{室|しつ}: chilled compartment (just above freezing)
- {製氷室|せいひょうしつ}: ice-making compartment
